description: This file contains utility classes, functions, and error handling mechanisms for interacting with OpenAI APIs within a larger machine learning or AI library. It defines custom exceptions, utility functions for error processing, and a base class for managing OpenAI client instances with caching and configuration management.

classes.name: OpenAIError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors from OpenAI API interactions, encapsulating HTTP status, request, response, and body information.

classes.name: BaseOpenAILLM
classes.description: Base class providing methods to retrieve and cache OpenAI client instances with configuration management, including SSL settings and internal caching.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] drop_params_from_unprocessable_entity_error( e: Union[openai.UnprocessableEntityError, httpx.HTTPStatusError], data: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Processes an OpenAI UnprocessableEntityError or HTTPStatusError to remove parameters that caused the error from the data dict.

methods.description: Retrieves a cached OpenAI client instance based on provided initialization parameters.

methods.description: Stores an OpenAI client instance in the cache with an associated cache key derived from its parameters.

methods.name: str get_openai_client_cache_key( client_initialization_params: dict, client_type: Literal["openai", "azure"] )
